<a id="mainthread"></a>

## `MainThread`

static class · `CwyLs.ModLoader.Threading.MainThread` · assembly `CwyLs.ModLoader`

The framework's one main-thread dispatcher: run work on Unity's main thread from any thread, now or after a delay, fire-and-forget or awaited with a timeout, plus per-frame tickers. Every feature host and every mod uses this instead of a queue of its own.

The logic is [`MainThreadQueue`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Threading.md#mainthreadqueue) in Core (unit-tested); this class owns the one instance, the clock (a `Stopwatch`, readable from any thread), the frame budget (`[MainThread] FrameBudgetMs`) and the hidden `DontDestroyOnLoad` host that pumps it once a frame (`MainThreadHost`; plugin components die ~0.2 s after boot in this game).

Owners: framework features pass a short name (`satone.motion`); a mod's helper passes `mod:<id>`, so its failures are attributed to it and its work is dropped when it stops. Framework work runs in full every frame; mod work runs after it, within [`MainThread.FrameBudgetMs`](#mainthread--framebudgetms), one mod at a time in turn (two lanes).

<a id="mainthread--defaultinvoketimeout"></a>

### `static readonly TimeSpan DefaultInvokeTimeout`

The caller-side wall-clock timeout an invocation gets when it names none: 2 s, at least 20 frames at the game's lowest frame-rate setting and 48 at its unfocused default of 24 fps. Pass `Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan` to wait forever.

<a id="mainthread--invoke-string-action-timespan-string"></a>

### `static void Invoke(string label, Action work, TimeSpan timeout, string owner = "cwy")`

Runs work on the main thread and blocks until it is done: inline on the main thread, otherwise up to `timeout`.

**Parameters**

- `label`: What the work is.
- `work`: The work; its exception is rethrown to the caller.
- `timeout`: How long a background caller waits.
- `owner`: Who is asking.

**Exceptions**

- `TimeoutException`: The main thread did not run it in time.
- [`MainThreadRejectedException`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Threading.md#mainthreadrejectedexception): The dispatcher refused the work.

<a id="mainthread--invoke-string-func-t-timespan-string"></a>

### `static T Invoke<T>(string label, Func<T> work, TimeSpan timeout, string owner = "cwy")`

Runs a function on the main thread and blocks until it returns: inline on the main thread, otherwise up to `timeout`.

**Type parameters**

- `T`: The result type.

**Parameters**

- `label`: What the work is.
- `work`: The function; its exception is rethrown to the caller.
- `timeout`: How long a background caller waits.
- `owner`: Who is asking.

**Returns:** The function's result.

**Exceptions**

- `TimeoutException`: The main thread did not run it in time.
- [`MainThreadRejectedException`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Threading.md#mainthreadrejectedexception): The dispatcher refused the work.

<a id="mainthread--invokeasync-string-action-timespan-cancellationtoken-string"></a>

### `static Task InvokeAsync(string label, Action work, TimeSpan? timeout = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, string owner = "cwy")`

Runs work on the main thread; the task ends when it ran, threw, timed out or was cancelled.

**Parameters**

- `label`: What the work is.
- `work`: The work; its exception faults the task.
- `timeout`: Wall-clock limit on the caller's side; null means [`MainThread.DefaultInvokeTimeout`](#mainthread--defaultinvoketimeout) (2 s), `Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan` (or anything above ~24.8 days) waits forever. Work not started by then is skipped.
- `cancellationToken`: Stops the wait and, if not yet started, the work.
- `owner`: Who is asking.

**Returns:** The task; a refusal faults it with [`MainThreadRejectedException`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Threading.md#mainthreadrejectedexception).

<a id="mainthread--invokeasync-string-func-t-timespan-cancellationtoken-string"></a>

### `static Task<T> InvokeAsync<T>(string label, Func<T> work, TimeSpan? timeout = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, string owner = "cwy")`

Runs a function on the main thread and hands back its result through a task.

**Type parameters**

- `T`: The result type.

**Parameters**

- `label`: What the work is.
- `work`: The function; its exception faults the task.
- `timeout`: Wall-clock limit on the caller's side; null means [`MainThread.DefaultInvokeTimeout`](#mainthread--defaultinvoketimeout).
- `cancellationToken`: Stops the wait and, if not yet started, the work.
- `owner`: Who is asking.

**Returns:** The task; a refusal faults it with [`MainThreadRejectedException`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Threading.md#mainthreadrejectedexception).

<a id="mainthread--post"></a>

### `static bool Post(string label, Action work, string owner = "cwy")`

Queues work for the next pump, even on the main thread.

**Parameters**

- `label`: What the work is, for failure lines.
- `work`: The work; its exceptions are logged, never rethrown.
- `owner`: Who is posting; see the class remarks.

**Returns:** True when queued; false when the queue was full (logged) or the game is quitting.

<a id="mainthread--postafter"></a>

### `static DelayedWork PostAfter(double seconds, string label, Action work)`

Runs framework work on the first pump at least `seconds` from now (real time).

**Parameters**

- `seconds`: The delay; unaffected by `Time.timeScale` or a paused game. Zero or less is [`MainThread.Post`](#mainthread--post).
- `label`: What the work is.
- `work`: The work; its exceptions are logged, never rethrown.

**Returns:** A handle: dispose it to cancel the work before it runs. [`DelayedWork.IsAccepted`](CwyLs.ModLoader.Core.Threading.md#delayedwork--isaccepted) is false when the delayed queue was full (logged) or the game is quitting.

<a id="mainthread--runorpost"></a>

### `static bool RunOrPost(string label, Action work, string owner = "cwy")`

Runs work now on the main thread, otherwise queues it for the next pump.

**Parameters**

- `label`: What the work is.
- `work`: The work; its exceptions are logged, never rethrown.
- `owner`: Who is posting.

**Returns:** True when it ran or was queued.
